parameters.combination_rule: LLM adds at most +/-1.0 to the variant's final signal-panel value, only where the technical score > 0 (inactive stays 0: the LLM never creates a trade alone), only when agreement >= 0.7 and both confidences >= 0.6; sign disagreement neutralises the contribution to 0. Agreement = 1 - |haiku - sonnet| / 2; combined = mean of the two scores when no sign disagreement. The contribution is added to the final panel value (post any volatility scaling), so the +/-1.0 cap holds exactly.
parameters.exit_gate: PASS iff (SG1) holdout net return at 10bps, combined > base; (SG2) holdout net return at 20bps, combined > base; (SG3) holdout net return at 10bps, combined > 0. Any sub-gate failing = FAIL: variant dropped per the kill rule. Other variant pairs (v1/v2/v3 +/- LLM) are supporting evidence only. Train return, Deflated Sharpe (n_trials=18), alpha/beta vs SPY, cost drag, trade counts are diagnostics, not gates.
parameters.haiku_scope: Every train filing current on >=1 train day where any variant's technical score > 0 for that symbol (in-scope set: 1,166 filings by dry-run count; estimated Haiku cost $2.59).
parameters.note_on_min_decision_score: min_decision_score 10.25 is a live-path (strategy_runner) parameter; the research engine selects top-5 by score with no threshold, identical to v1/v2, so the base-vs-combined comparison stays apples-to-apples. Technical composite scores range 0-5.5.
parameters.scoring_scope: Filings dated <= 2026-08-17 only (train window). Holdout decisions use the latest scored filing per symbol carried forward (up to ~3 months stale). No holdout-window filing is scored: strictest out-of-sample discipline. Limitation: holdout sentiment is stale by construction, which biases the holdout test against the LLM leg.
parameters.sonnet_adjudication_rule: Adjudicate only near-threshold filings: on >=1 train day while current, the symbol is decision-relevant, i.e. its technical score T satisfies T > cutoff-1.0 AND T < sixth+1.0 (cutoff = 5th largest positive score that day, sixth = 6th largest; a +/-1.0 LLM adjustment could move the symbol in/out of the top-5), for any variant. Rank candidates by decision-relevance count (relevant (filing,day,variant) triples) descending, tie-break Haiku confidence ascending then filing_date ascending. Take filings in rank order until the $5.00 Sonnet sub-budget (estimated cost per filing from excerpt_chars) would be exceeded. Filings with Haiku confidence < 0.6 are never adjudicated (gate requires both confidences >= 0.6). Where Sonnet does not adjudicate, the LLM contribution is 0 (no second opinion, no adjustment).
